profile.legalName: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University
profile.summary: Stanford University is a private nonprofit research university in Stanford, California. It is governed by its Board of Trustees. It offers undergraduate and graduate education and carries out research, including education research through its Graduate School of Education.

sources.title: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University - Full Filing - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: This is the same organization OUSD contracts with. ProPublica shows The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University, a nonprofit in Stanford, CA, with EIN 94-1156365, and Stanford's contact page lists 450 Jane Stanford Way, Stanford, CA 94305 and (650) 723-2300. The homepage supports the website and the neutral summary: it describes Stanford as a research and teaching institution, mentions undergraduate and graduate students, and lists Education among its seven schools; 'private' and 'governed by its Board of Trustees' are not stated outright but follow from the nonprofit status and the legal name.
